scripts.nxWithTtl:
if redis.call('SET', KEYS[1], ARGV[1], 'NX', 'KEEPTTL') then
        return redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[2])
      else
        return 0
      end
scripts.hReplaceStampedEx:
redis.call('DEL', KEYS[1])
      local stamp = ARGV[3]
      if redis.call('EXISTS', KEYS[2]) == 1 then stamp = ARGV[4] end
      redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], ARGV[2], stamp, unpack(ARGV, 5))
      return redis.call('EXPIRE', KEYS[1], ARGV[1])

cases.name: cold
cases.about: three cold images (one requested twice): two with rows, one with none (a notFound marker, 5 min); image 8002 has a recent-event marker, so its stamp is aged

queries.query:
SELECT
            entityId,
            metricType,
            sum(total) AS value
          FROM (
            SELECT entityId, metricType, day, total
            FROM entityMetricDailyAgg_v2
            WHERE entityType = 'Image'
              AND entityId IN (8001,8002,8003)
              AND metricType IN ('Cry','Heart','Laugh','Like','Collection','commentCount','tippedAmount','tippedCount')
          )
          GROUP BY entityId, metricType
          HAVING value > 0;
queries.wire:
SELECT
            entityId,
            metricType,
            sum(total) AS value
          FROM (

          )
          GROUP BY entityId, metricType

FORMAT JSONEachRow
